in_hebrew.name: Hanover
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hanover הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'hanweor', meaning 'one who rules over the town'. This name was often given to someone who held a position of authority in a local community.
